text:
Fiona: Quick sync on Kepler beta enrollment window (next Mon). Aim: 3 waves, ~120 total seats, mix of AE-handled and self-serve. Need final enroll CSV + invite cadence + two feedback touchpoints.

Omar: I'll export the CSV. Which fields? email, company, seats, owner, timezone, renewal_bucket, flags, notes.

Jules: Add 'preferred_contact_method' (email/calendar/phone) so we can pick AE vs self-serve path. Also a 'pilot_priority' tag for VIP routing.

Becky: For invites, let's avoid large spikes on runtime. Plan: 15 invites / 30 minutes per region, escalate to AE if invite bounce.

Fiona: Upload path: https://drive.redwood.co/kepler/enrollments_final.csv. Please use template 'kepler-vip' or 'kepler-standard' based on pilot_priority.

Omar: CSV uploaded (link above). 118 rows; 22 VIP seats. Timezones skew to GMT/UTC.

Jules: Survey plan: pre-survey (single Q use-case), D5 micro-NPS in-app for non-EU, email fallback for EU/legal rows. D21 longer feedback + opt-in interview. I'll own copy + send schedule.

Becky: Dev note: feature gate flag kepler_alpha=true required. Also add telemetry events: session_started and first_query_success. I'll add a dashboard tile under CS > Kepler.

DeployBot: Reminder: runbook "kepler-invite-playbook" scheduled 2026-05-02T13:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.co/kepler/invite-playbook.md

Omar: Example invite API (for devs):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.co/v1/invites \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","template":"kepler-standard","flags":["kepler_alpha"]}'
```

Fiona: Owners: @Omar enrollment CSV + ingest, @Jules surveys + interview scheduling, @Becky invite routing + instrumentation, @Fiona program lead.

Jules: One risk: a cluster of accounts behind strict corporate proxies. If calendar invites fail, we'll switch to AE manual and offer a pre-signed onboarding link.

Becky: Noted. I'll add a 'calendar_block' column for known accounts and tag them during ingest.

Fiona: Thanks. Next quick check-in tomorrow 11:00 PT. Post any copy or runbook edits here. :sparkles:
